checks.evidence: 1-second read: '5 Sa të kthen çdo euro' over a euro coin standing on its edge, the red phone behind it. Sound off it reads 'number 5: what each euro brings back'.
Matches alt text 6: one euro coin standing upright on the table (region_SL06_coin_2x.jpg).
No invented number: the '1' and 'EURO' are the coin's own design, not a claim; the phone screen is dark. No em dash.
No people, hands or limbs in any of the 9 tiles.
No hands; still life.
No faces.
The coin stands on its rim with a contact point, a cast shadow to the left and a stretched reflection in the varnish (tile_r3c2.jpg, tile_r3c3.jpg); balanced, not floating.

Pre-existing (same in v1). The €1 coin is rendered in one metal: centre and ring share the same brass hue (centre RGB 66/39/16 and 73/46/23, ring 106/61/18 and 113/68/23, R/G about 1.7 in both), while a real €1 coin has a silver-coloured centre inside a gold-coloured ring (region_SL06_coin_2x.jpg). The common-side design (large 1, EURO, map, lines with stars, designer initials) is otherwise right. A viewer who handles euros could notice; most will read 'a euro coin'.

Read at 2x and 4x. Kicker: N-U-M-R-I / I / P-E-S-T-Ë. Headline (region_SL06_headline_2x.jpg): [5 in crimson box] S-a / t-ë / k-t-h-e-n // ç-d-o / e-u-r-o = 'Sa të kthen çdo euro' as in the alt text, cedilla on the ç. Subline: T-ë / a-r-d-h-u-r-a-t / n-g-a / k-ë-t-a / k-l-i-e-n-t-ë, // p-j-e-s-ë-t-u-a-r / m-e / s-h-p-e-n-z-i-m-i-n. Every ë has two dots; comma and full stop correct. No misspelling, no em dash. The stray speck that earlier QA removed beside the ë of 'të' is still gone (region_SL06_te_4x.jpg, region_SL06_headline_2x.jpg; a speck search of the text area finds only the box corners and window bokeh).

The text is the house overlay, set on the calm dark wall area left of the window (region_SL06_headline_2x.jpg, tile_r1c1.jpg). Nothing in the scene sits in front of a letter and no letter is painted onto a prop, skin or cloth.
No unwanted text: the coin's legend is its real design; no signage or screen text.
The story prop is present, large and in focus.
Deep red case (out of focus behind the coin), same phone look. Coin accuracy is under V8.
Only the coin and the phone; nothing unexplained.
No characters, so no character sheet applies.
Phone lies dark in the background: the story's focus moved to the euro, consistent with the thread.
Same set: table by the window, plaza and clock tower.

1080x1350 (4:5). Kicker y63-81; headline two lines y168-345; subline y374-444; left margin ~100 px; counter '6/7' x934-980, y52-76; arrow x929-987, y1232-1291 (centre 1261.5); logo x98-393, y1238-1295 (centre 1266.5). Logo and arrow on one line (5 px apart). All content inside the frame.
At 200 px the headline and the standing coin read clearly.
Still life with no people in the scene; the window background is alive enough for the format (street lamps, lit facades, wet plaza with reflections, out-of-focus cars), the same on every slide.

Tirana at night, warm tungsten, ivory type (#FAF8F3), crimson box #A70D15, arrow #A41116, gold in the counter (#CB9944) and the logo's square; the coin's brass is a scene material, not graphic colour.
Photoreal night interior: wood grain with specular highlights, bokeh street lights, wet plaza, fine grain (tiles r2c3, r3c2). No plastic or CG look.

No artefacts: the real logo lands on v1's drawn footprint (only 92 px refilled outside it); grain continuous at 2x, 3x gamma and CLAHE (region_logozone_orig_vs_fixed_2x.jpg, region_logozone_band_orig_top_fixed_bottom_3x_gamma07.jpg, region_logozone_clahe_orig_top_fixed_bottom_2x.jpg); no seam, smear or blotch. Outside the zone only JPEG noise (max 28, mean 1.06). No stray specks in the text area.

Logo is the real file (../SET/ref_logo_vs_pasted_all_slides_3x.jpg, region_logozone_orig_vs_fixed_2x.jpg): red rounded square with the S-shaped channel, gold square in the top-right notch, white 'StraightScale' wordmark, identical to /home/user/brand/straightscale-logo-light.png. Fitting the real file at 295x57 at (98,1238) gives a mean absolute difference of 7.13 levels over its opaque pixels (the same 7.1 to 7.2 on all seven slides, i.e. one file at one scale); the opaque extent measures 291x54 px (aspect 5.39) vs the file's alpha bbox 1501x279 (5.38), so it is undistorted; edges crisp at 3x. No remnant of the v1 drawn logo: the plain white 'S' block and the drawn wordmark are gone, no ghost letters, no red or gold fragment in the cleared area (0 red and 0 gold pixels outside the pasted logo in the change zone; boosted and CLAHE views show only wood grain). No other brand's mark anywhere: the coin (currency design, not a brand) or phone carries no maker logo.
No before and after, no 'your [condition]', nothing that shames; the copy is a neutral instruction.

No AI person in the frame. Photoreal AI scene: STANDARDS.md section 7 asks for Instagram's own AI label on the post (a posting setting, not visible in the image); no burned-in AI tag is present, which is correct.
